4279-5933-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5933-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1719-2645-3430-6256.easyPrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands doesn't have summoning sickness.
1719-2645-3430-6256.description:
Activate Muraganda Raceway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Muraganda Raceway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

222-527-3899-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-6633.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1308-4772-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

573-2438-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

4300-6628-7857.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
4300-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

2436-4091-7791.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Marwyn.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Marwyn.
Repeat.

141-2292-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-2292-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

240-4452-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4452-5147.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6705-7296.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1169-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1491-2757-6218-7267.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3227-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3227-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Palinchron
When Scrivener and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3227-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

4476-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Answered Prayers triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4476-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

628-2438-6672.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

803-1308-3951-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
803-1308-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-3362-5686-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2397-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2538-3558-3676-4052.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to return Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

323-1339-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
323-1339-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

4871-5231-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Brokkos, adding {R}.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {R}{R}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

1368-2196-2492.notablePrerequisites:
You have an additional six cards in your graveyard if both Bonus Round and Frantic Search are in your graveyard, or you have an additional three cards in your graveyard if either card is in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
1368-2196-2492.description:
Cast Bonus Round either from your hand by paying {1}{R}{R} or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Frantic Search if its in your graveyard, causing any instant or sorcery cast this turn to be copied.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search either from your hand by paying {2}{U}, or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Bonus Round triggers, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the original Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat from step 2.

1335-2249-5231.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2249-5231.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {R}.
When the Elemental dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marath.
Repeat.

703-2726-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

224-322-2167-2248.notablePrerequisites:
Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Forest.
224-322-2167-2248.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a basic Forest, adding {G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, causing you to put the basic Forest from your graveyard into your hand.
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting the basic Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2646-3026-4302-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Angel.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2646-3026-4302-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing an Angel, adding {R}.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

586-2170-2232-3168.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Kalastria Healer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix ability, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Kalastria Healer by paying {B}.
Kalastria Healer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Kalastria Healer's ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
